resources.string: Hold A: accents · L1/R1 move cursor · L2 hide · R2 big text · R3 stick typing
Left stick: group · right stick: letter, let go to type · B delete · X space · Y shift · START enter · R3 keys
Android TV keyboard on. To come back: Settings > System > Languages & input > On-screen keyboard > Gamepad keyboard.
Select to use the Android TV keyboard instead (the one older builds had)
Select to use the Gamepad keyboard again
Open the keyboard with the two stick circles instead of the keys. R3 switches at any time.
Show the text when the keyboard hides it
If the text field ends up under the keyboard, show the text in a big line above it. R2 does this by hand.
The line above the keys and the button names on keys

D-pad or left stick: move
A: type (hold for accents: é, ü, ß…)
B: delete (on an empty field: close)
X: space
Y: shift (twice: caps lock)
L1 / R1: move the text cursor
L2: close the keyboard
R2: big text line on or off
Start: enter / done
Select: letters or symbols
L3: switch to the Android TV keyboard
R3: key grid or stick typing

Stick typing: the left stick picks a group of four, the right stick points at a letter, let it go to type it.
